metadata.title: Pondicherry University (PU) Campus - Detailed Apple Maps 3D Reference Specification

facts_verified.note: Names, descriptions, fact chips and floor counts were checked against Pondicherry University sources and OpenStreetMap tags. A null floor count means no source states it.
sources: OpenStreetMap (building tags and bus stops), © OpenStreetMap contributors

typography.primary_font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

north_boys_hostels.name: North Boys Hostel Village & Mega Mess

campus_sectors.name: Silver Jubilee Campus (SJC)
campus_sectors.primary_function: Advanced Postgraduate Studies, Humanities, Social Sciences, Media, and Management
campus_sectors.character: Modern academic quadrangles, tree-lined avenues, landscaped parking plazas

campus_sectors.name: Central campus
campus_sectors.primary_function: Central Library, University Secretariat, Senate Hall, Examination Wing, and Central Canteens
campus_sectors.character: Monumental circular library rotunda, sprawling lawns, clock tower, convocation auditoriums

campus_sectors.name: Science blocks
campus_sectors.primary_function: Physical, Chemical, Biological, Earth Sciences, and Nanotechnology Research
campus_sectors.character: Intensive laboratory blocks, high-tech cleanrooms, electron microscopy bunkers, solar testbeds

campus_sectors.name: Boys hostels
campus_sectors.primary_function: Student Residential Quadrangles, Central Messes, Gymnasium, and Indoor Arena
campus_sectors.character: Dense quadrangle residential blocks surrounding huge dining mess halls and active student plazas

campus_sectors.name: Girls hostels
campus_sectors.primary_function: Female Scholar Residences, 24/7 University Health Clinic, Temple, and Botanical Nursery
campus_sectors.character: Serene green residential parkway, 24/7 security perimeter, shaded palm groves

campus_sectors.name: Stadiums and courts
campus_sectors.primary_function: Track & Field, Cricket, Football, Tennis, Basketball, and Mass Tournaments
campus_sectors.character: Expansive terracotta 400m running track, emerald turf fields, spectator pavilions

campus_sectors.name: Gates and East Coast Road
campus_sectors.primary_function: Access Control, Ceremonial Gates, Transit Termini, and Coastal Buffer
campus_sectors.character: Four-lane highway arterial, monumental archways, bus stations, coastal coconut palms

buildings.name: Silver Jubilee Campus (SJC)
buildings.description: The northern part of the university: Social Sciences, Humanities, Tamil, Mass Communication, UMISARC and the teacher training centre.

buildings.name: Department of Electronic Media and Mass Communication
buildings.formal_name: Department of Electronic Media and Mass Communication
buildings.description: School of Media & Communication, started in 2007. Video and audio studios, a multimedia lab and the Educational Multimedia Research Centre.

buildings.name: School of Social Sciences & International Studies
buildings.formal_name: School of Social Sciences & International Studies
buildings.description: Dean's office, on the ground floor of the central block. The school's departments are in the wings around it.

buildings.name: Library, School of Social Sciences
buildings.description: Reference library of the School of Social Sciences, one of five school libraries set up in 2011.

buildings.name: School of Humanities
buildings.description: Dean's office, on the ground floor of the central block; the school began in December 2004. Its departments are in the wings around it.

buildings.name: Library, School of Humanities
buildings.description: Reference library of the School of Humanities.

buildings.name: Department of History
buildings.description: School of Social Sciences wing; the department has both floors.

buildings.name: Departments of Social Work and Sociology
buildings.formal_name: Departments of Social Work and Sociology
buildings.description: School of Social Sciences wing: Social Work on the ground floor, Sociology on the first.

buildings.name: Centre for Study of Social Inclusion
buildings.formal_name: Centre for Study of Social Inclusion
buildings.description: School of Social Sciences wing; the centre is on the ground floor.

buildings.name: Department of Anthropology
buildings.description: School of Social Sciences wing; Anthropology is on the ground floor.

buildings.name: Department of Politics & International Studies
buildings.description: School of Social Sciences wing: Politics & International Studies on the ground floor, the Centre for Women's Studies on the first.

buildings.name: Department of English
buildings.description: School of Humanities wing; the department has both floors.

buildings.name: Department of French
buildings.description: School of Humanities wing: French on the ground floor and the Centre for Foreign Languages on the first.

buildings.name: Departments of Philosophy and Education
buildings.description: Philosophy on the ground floor and Education on the first.

buildings.name: Departments of Sanskrit and Hindi
buildings.description: School of Humanities wing: Sanskrit on the ground floor, Hindi on the first. A tea and snack cafe is in this wing.

buildings.name: Department of Applied Psychology
buildings.description: Started in 2007-08, on the ground floor of its wing beside the Humanities block. Two psychology laboratories.

buildings.name: Department of Food Science and Technology
buildings.formal_name: Department of Food Science and Technology
buildings.description: School of Life Sciences. Food-processing pilot plant for canning, spray drying, baking and freeze drying. M.Sc. and Ph.D. programmes.

buildings.name: Subramania Bharathi School of Tamil Language & Literature
buildings.formal_name: Subramania Bharathi School of Tamil Language & Literature
buildings.description: One of the first schools planned when the university was founded in 1985. B.A. (Hons), M.A. and Ph.D. in Tamil.

buildings.name: UNESCO Madanjeet Singh Institute of South Asia Regional Cooperation (UMISARC)
buildings.formal_name: UMISARC – Centre for South Asian Studies
buildings.description: Centre for South Asian Studies, inaugurated on 29 June 2012. Air-conditioned building with an auditorium, seminar hall, computer lab and its own library.
amenities_inside: M.A. and Ph.D. South Asian Studies

buildings.name: UGC-Malaviya Mission Teacher Training Centre (MMTTC)
buildings.description: Trains university and college teachers: induction, refresher and short-term courses. Formerly the UGC Human Resource Development Centre.

buildings.name: SJC Canteen & Cultural Centre
buildings.description: Canteen on the ground floor and the Cultural Centre upstairs, for the Silver Jubilee Campus schools.

buildings.name: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2
buildings.description: Central government school on the university campus, classes I to XII. Opened in 1986; in its own building since 2004.

buildings.name: Ananda Rangapillai Library (Central Library)
buildings.description: The university's main library, founded in 1986 and in this building since 1990. About 2.4 lakh printed volumes and 2.8 lakh e-resources; a UN depository library.

buildings.name: Book Shop
buildings.description: Book shop beside the Ananda Rangapillai Library.

buildings.name: Library Annexe (Reading Hall)
buildings.description: Reading rooms, discussion rooms, the Louis Braille Centre and a cafeteria. The Department of Library & Information Science is on the second floor.

buildings.name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Administrative Building
buildings.description: The Registrar's office and the Executive Council Hall. The J.N. Auditorium is part of the building and the post office is next to it.

buildings.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Auditorium
buildings.description: Air-conditioned auditorium with 550 seats, in the Administrative Building.

buildings.name: Convention Centre
buildings.description: The university's new convention centre near Gate 2, designed with a 2,500-seat auditorium. Handed over to the university in June 2025.

buildings.name: Examination Building
buildings.description: The Examinations Wing under the Controller of Examinations: Arts & Science, Engineering, Medical, Convocation and distance-education sections.

buildings.name: Students Welfare Centre
buildings.description: Office of the Dean, Students' Welfare.

buildings.name: Bicycle Service Point
buildings.description: Service point for bicycles, with air filling. The university provides free bicycles on campus.

buildings.name: Canteen I
buildings.description: South Indian food at low prices, near the Administrative Building. A Ponlait milk booth is beside it.

buildings.name: Ponlait Booth
buildings.description: Milk booth of Ponlait, the Puducherry co-operative dairy, beside Canteen I.

buildings.name: Shopping Complex
buildings.description: University-run shops: the A–Z Store, a bakery and coffee shop, an air-conditioned restaurant, a fruit and vegetable shop, a browsing centre and a tea shop.

buildings.name: Indian Bank, Pondicherry University Branch
buildings.description: The only bank branch on campus. Its two ATMs are near Gate 1 and near Science Block I.

buildings.name: PU Staff Co-operative Credit Society
buildings.formal_name: Pondicherry University Staff Co-operative Credit Society Ltd.
buildings.description: Thrift and credit society for university staff, in the Administrative Building.

buildings.name: Department of Management Studies
buildings.description: School of Management. The university's first MBA started here in 1986; MBA, BBA and Ph.D. programmes and a 150-seat seminar hall.

buildings.name: School of Management
buildings.description: Houses the departments of Commerce, Economics, International Business, Tourism Studies and Banking Technology, with a 200-seat seminar hall.

buildings.name: Lecture Hall Complex 2
buildings.description: Shared lecture halls beside the Department of Management Studies.

buildings.name: Canteen III
buildings.description: Beside the School of Management. North Indian food and chaats, South Indian meals and Chinese, with an air-conditioned section.

buildings.name: Centre for Distance and Online Education (DDE)
buildings.formal_name: Centre for Distance and Online Education
buildings.description: Formerly the Directorate of Distance Education; distance courses since 1995-96. Its library is on the first floor.

buildings.name: Department of Computer Science
buildings.description: In Science Block II; School of Engineering & Technology. Labs for programming, IoT, Linux, drones, networks and high-performance computing.

buildings.name: Department of Chemistry
buildings.description: School of Physical, Chemical and Applied Sciences, since 1989. NMR, mass spectrometry and X-ray diffraction instruments.

buildings.name: Science Block I
buildings.description: Science departments block near Gate 2. One of the Indian Bank ATMs is beside it.

buildings.name: Department of Physics
buildings.description: School of Physical, Chemical and Applied Sciences, since June 1987. X-ray diffraction, an atomic force microscope, lasers and a computing cluster.

buildings.name: Department of Biotechnology
buildings.description: School of Life Sciences, established in 1992. Plant tissue culture, animal cell culture and an animal house.

buildings.name: Department of Bioinformatics
buildings.description: School of Life Sciences. Began in 1991 as a bioinformatics centre and became a department in 2021. Three computer labs, 13 research labs and a library.

buildings.name: Department of Earth Sciences
buildings.description: Started in September 1994. Geology museum of about 800 specimens; geochemistry, isotope and geophysics labs.

buildings.name: Ramanujan School of Mathematical Sciences
buildings.description: Departments of Mathematics (1986) and Statistics (2006), with a 100-seat seminar hall and a computer lab.

buildings.name: Madanjeet School of Green Energy Technologies
buildings.formal_name: Madanjeet School of Green Energy Technologies
buildings.description: Founded in 2010. Department of Green Energy Technology and the Centre for Nano Sciences & Technology.

buildings.name: HRTEM Centre
buildings.formal_name: High Resolution Transmission Electron Microscope Facility
buildings.description: High Resolution Transmission Electron Microscope facility, part of the Central Instrumentation Facility.

buildings.name: Horticulture Wing
buildings.description: The university's Horticulture Wing.

buildings.name: Lecture Hall Complex 1
buildings.description: Shared lecture halls in the science area.

buildings.name: Canteen II
buildings.description: South Indian food near the Science Block.

buildings.name: Department of Performing Arts
buildings.description: School of Performing Arts, established in 1988-89. Three air-conditioned studio theatres and an open-air theatre, beside Gate 1.

buildings.name: Studio Theatre 1
buildings.description: One of the Department of Performing Arts' three air-conditioned studio theatres, the Sri Sankaradass Swamigal Lab.

buildings.name: Studio Theatre 2
buildings.description: One of the Department of Performing Arts' three air-conditioned studio theatres, the Pammal Samandha Mudhaliar Lab.

buildings.name: Studio Theatre 3
buildings.description: One of the Department of Performing Arts' three air-conditioned studio theatres, the TKS Brothers Lab.

buildings.name: Tagore Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2001-02. 66 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: Kalidas Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2002-03. 46 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: Kamban Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 1994-95. 66 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: MAKA Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2010-11. 80 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: Kabirdas Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2008-09. 81 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: Kannadasan Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2007-08. 80 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: Valmiki Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2007-08. 78 rooms.

buildings.name: SRK Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2010-11. 81 double rooms. Residents eat at Amudham Mess.

buildings.name: C.V. Raman Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2011-12. 177 single and double rooms, 40 of them air-conditioned for foreign students. Residents eat at Ilango Adigal Mess. The Chief Warden (Boys) office is here.

buildings.name: Subramania Bharathi Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 1990-91. 62 rooms. Its mess is run by research scholars.

buildings.name: Ilango Adigal Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2006-07. 77 double rooms. Has its own Ilango Adigal Mess.

buildings.name: Pavendar Bharathidasan Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 1990-91. 62 rooms. Its mess is run by research scholars.

buildings.name: Sri Aurobindo Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2016-17. 182 double rooms on a ground floor and five floors above. Residents eat at Annapurna Mess.

buildings.name: Birsa Munda Hostel
buildings.footprint_source: Outline traced from satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, February 2023); not yet in OpenStreetMap
buildings.description: New boys' hostel in two blocks, A and B, just north of Sri Aurobindo Hostel. Residents eat at Annapurna Mess.

buildings.name: Amudham Mess
buildings.description: Boys' mess for Kalidas, MAKA, Tagore, Kabirdas, Kamban, Kannadasan and SRK hostels.

buildings.name: Annapurna Mess (Mega Mess)
buildings.description: Boys' mess for Sri Aurobindo and Birsa Munda hostels. Students call it the Mega Mess.

buildings.name: Gents Gym
buildings.description: Men's multi-gym for students and staff, among the boys' hostels.

buildings.name: Swami Vivekananda Multi Purpose Hall
buildings.description: Indoor hall for table tennis, chess and carrom.

buildings.name: Madame Curie Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 2011-12. 256 rooms including the foreign students’ section, 49 of them air-conditioned. Has its own Madame Curie Mess. The Chief Warden (Girls) office is here.

buildings.name: Foreign Hostel
buildings.description: For foreign women students, run with Madame Curie Hostel, which keeps 49 air-conditioned rooms for them. Residents eat at Madame Curie Mess.

buildings.name: Kalpana Chawla Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 2010-11. 73 rooms. Residents eat at Madame Curie Mess.

buildings.name: Ganga Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 2006-07. 72 rooms. Has its own Ganga Mess.

buildings.name: Yamuna Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 2002-03. 40 rooms. Residents eat at Madame Curie Mess.

buildings.name: Cauvery Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 1994-95. 76 rooms. Residents eat at Ganga Mess.

buildings.name: Saraswathy Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 1999-00. 32 rooms. Residents eat at Ganga Mess.

buildings.name: Narmadha Hostel
buildings.description: Girls' hostel, opened 2019. 182 rooms on a ground floor and five floors above. Residents eat at Mother Teresa Mess. Inaugurated on 23 December 2019.

buildings.name: Kannagi Hostel
buildings.footprint_source: Outline traced from satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, February 2023); not yet in OpenStreetMap
buildings.description: New girls' hostel in three blocks, A, B and C, north-west of Narmadha Hostel. Residents eat at Mother Teresa Mess. The campus bus stops here.

buildings.name: Savithribai Phule Hostel
buildings.footprint_source: Outline traced from satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, February 2023); not yet in OpenStreetMap. The university has not published which building this is; the position is the new block between Narmadha and Kannagi hostels
buildings.description: New girls' hostel between Narmadha and Kannagi hostels. Residents eat at Mother Teresa Mess.

buildings.name: MSME Hostel for Girls
buildings.footprint_source: Approximate: a block in the MSME Technology Centre compound south of the campus, traced from satellite imagery. No source says which building the hostel is
buildings.description: Hostel for women students at the MSME Technology Centre, just south of the campus. Run with Ganga Hostel; residents are attached to Ganga Mess.

buildings.name: Mother Teresa Mess
buildings.description: Girls' mess for Narmadha, Savithribai Phule and Kannagi hostels.

buildings.name: Faculty Quarters (F1–F40)
buildings.description: Staff housing, quarters F1 to F40.

buildings.name: Ladies Gym
buildings.description: Women's multi-gym, among the girls' hostels.

buildings.name: University Health Centre
buildings.description: Open round the clock, with an ambulance. Free medicines at the university counter 9:30 am–5:30 pm; serious cases are referred to the Government Hospital or JIPMER.

buildings.name: Sri Valampuri Vidya Vinayagar Temple
buildings.description: Hindu temple on campus. Its Maha Kumbabishegam was held on 8 September 2022.

buildings.name: Rajiv Gandhi Cricket Stadium
buildings.description: Cricket ground with turf wickets and floodlights; holds about 1,000 spectators.

buildings.name: Thiruvalluvar Stadium
buildings.description: 400 m cinder track with a football field inside; holds about 800 spectators.

buildings.name: Tennis, Basketball & Volleyball Courts
buildings.formal_name: Multi-sports complex, Directorate of Physical Education & Sports
buildings.description: Multi-sports complex of the Directorate of Physical Education & Sports.

buildings.name: Gate 1 (Main Gate)
buildings.description: Main gate on East Coast Road. Visitors’ IDs are checked here, and the in-campus buses start and end here.

buildings.name: Gate 2
buildings.description: Second gate on East Coast Road, south of Gate 1 on the Science Block side. Visitors’ IDs are checked here.

buildings.name: Gender Gate
buildings.description: Students' name for the gate between the boys' and girls' hostel areas.

buildings.name: Foreign Students Hostel
buildings.description: Boys' hostel, opened 2011-12. 41 rooms. For foreign men students, near Gate 1.

buildings.name: Transit Hostel
buildings.description: Hostel building beside the Foreign Students Hostel, near Gate 1.

bus_stops.name: Gate 1 Bus Stop
bus_stops.description: In-campus buses start and end at Gate 1. A battery car and buses run to the library, the hostels and the Silver Jubilee Campus from about 8 am to 6 pm.

bus_stops.name: Library Bus Stop
bus_stops.description: On the in-campus bus route between Gate 1, the library, the hostels and the Silver Jubilee Campus.

bus_stops.description: On the in-campus bus route between Gate 1, the library, the hostels and the Silver Jubilee Campus.
